song_craft: Voice: hammer couplets, sealing register (measured, told, defended, sealed). Arc: secondaries measured (vv19–20) → course told (v21) → delusion denied (v22) → SEAL (v23: told/proved/unrefuted/useful + full apparatus besides). Sthāyin utsāha: exultation as measure, course, denial, seal land in turn. ekahānyā obscurity kept open throughout (BOUNDARY). L4 = L3 verbatim, music named.

lines: One short — yet by the chief, by the pure — secondaries fit each other —
the king's man, and the brahmin's.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ekahānyā pradhānena śuddhenānyānyayogitā syādguṇasya yathā rājñaḥ puruṣo brāhmaṇasya ca
notes: ekahānyā held open (one short of what?)

verses.craft: Measure without unit: One-short kept obscure per BOUNDARY (ekahānyā held open — no smoothing); examples do the measuring (kings man, brahmins).
verses.rejected: (a) defining the unit → killed by BOUNDARY: prose never defines it. (b) cutting examples → killed: examples ARE the measure.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+v19 UNC held open) / C1 essence / rasa vīra-sealing / NOTE + BOUNDARY (ekahānyā open, no forks)

lines: So by another chief — what other unity, or by still another —
secondaries called relation: the king's horse, man.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tathānyena pradhānena yaikatānyāpareṇa vā saṃbandhākhyā guṇasya syādrājño'śvaḥ puruṣo

verses.craft: Chiefs multiply, unity multiplies: other-chief-other-unity; horse/man examples kept.
verses.rejected: (a) one-unity universal → killed: plurality is the verse. (b) horse→elephant modernize → killed: vighna.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+v19 UNC held open) / C1 essence / rasa vīra-sealing / NOTE + BOUNDARY (ekahānyā open, no forks)

lines: So relation's course is told: intellects
resting on Māyā-knowers, of varied views, driving transaction.
l4.sanskrit_cite: iti saṃbandhagatyuktā māyīyajñātṛniṣṭhitāḥ dhiyo vibhinnārthadṛśo vyavahārapravartikāḥ

verses.craft: Course told: intellects resting on Māyā-knowers drive transaction — the world’s business given its drivers.
verses.rejected: (a) Māyā-knowers→the deluded → killed: resting (āśrita) is precise, not delusion (v22 denies that next). (b) transaction→business → killed: vyavahāra load term.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+v19 UNC held open) / C1 essence / rasa vīra-sealing / NOTE + BOUNDARY (ekahānyā open, no forks)

lines: Not deluded — though called erring, all of them,
moment by moment, grounded in endless-awareness reflection.
l4.sanskrit_cite: na paraṃ tāstathā bhrāntāḥ sarvā api pratikṣaṇāt svasaṃvitsaṃjñakānantacidvimarśapratiṣṭhitāḥ

verses.craft: Denial hammer: Not deluded — moment-by-moment grounded; relief without new machinery (rasa).
verses.rejected: (a) softening Not → killed: denial opens the verse. (b) endless-awareness→infinite consciousness → killed: L3 frozen.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+v19 UNC held open) / C1 essence / rasa vīra-sealing / NOTE + BOUNDARY (ekahānyā open, no forks)

lines: relation in recognition — full apparatus besides.
l4.sanskrit_cite: uktaḥ svasaṃvitsiddho'yaṃ nirbādha upayogavān saṃbandhaḥ pratyabhijñāyāṃ pūrṇaḥ parikaraḥ punaḥ

verses.craft: SEAL: fourfold apparatus in one line (told/proved/unrefuted/useful) + full-apparatus-besides close — treatise-close performed.
verses.rejected: (a) trimming fourfold → killed: apparatus is content. (b) besides→also → killed: besides keeps the beyond.
